reason: Edrin Moss (Keypath Repairs) said by phone that the work was completed on 19 Sept (event-23) and again on 25 Sept (event-25). These are only verbal claims. The file has no appointment, attendance record, visit notes or invoice (event-24). Edrin said on 17 Sept that they had tried three times, had not found Perrin in, and had not collected management keys (event-22). That conflicts with a 19 Sept completion unless keys were collected later, and nothing records that. Because of this I cannot report the work as done or close. The tenant is the one party who can confirm whether anyone attended and whether the locks and keys now work, so I asked Perrin (message-1). Tenant also reported mould in the bathroom (event-6) with no stated health impact or vulnerable occupant, so I asked about extent and health in the same message and did not escalate. If Perrin reports spreading mould or health effects, escalate as P1. Landlord approval (event-3) covers using our own provider but states no amount, and Keypath's assignment is shown only by the reassignment (events 12-15). When the promised invoice arrives it must be checked for property, provider and amount. Any amount must then go to the landlord for approval because none is approved. Escalation is not needed yet: no danger is reported, there is no invoice or dispute, and the tenant has not yet been asked. Waiting alone would leave the unverified completion claim untested. Follow-up is set for 48 hours. Keys are also unresolved, including whether any were held by the contractor.
message: Hello Perrin, the contractor (Keypath Repairs) has told us the lock work at Unit 2, 18 Brindlewick Mews was completed on Friday 19 September. We have no visit record, so we would like to check with you. Did anyone attend on or around that date, and did you let them in or did they use management keys? Does the bedroom window now lock, does the bathroom window open and lock, and have you been given keys, including for the kitchen window? If anything is still not working, please tell us what. You also mentioned mould in the bathroom. Could you tell us roughly how much there is and whether it is spreading or affecting anyone's health? Kind regards, Ilyra Venn, Northbridge Lettings
